main_idea: A simple prompt sharply cuts clutter across all four models compared with a raw prompt.
ideas: Raw prompt clutter varies by model
summary: Mostly clean, but stray left-axis percent labels add clutter, and the bars are misaligned with model labels, which makes the chart confusing.
defects: Left percent labels misaligned with model labels and bars
Bars overlap and are misaligned with the model rows
Raw and simple bars not clearly grouped per model
Models labels sit between gridlines, not beside their bars
Model name labels sit between rows, not beside their bars
Bars and value labels are offset from their axis rows
The 61% bar sits in the row labelled Claude Sonnet 5.5
Value 46% and 42% bars overlap vertically and crowd together
Axis shows 0 to 80 numbers next to percent row labels, mixing scales
Bar-to-model mapping is unreadable, so the chart cannot be trusted
Model row labels do not line up with their bars; reader cannot tell which bar belongs to which model
Y-axis percentage ticks (60, 45, 30, 15, 0) do not match the model rows
Simple-prompt bars start at a different x-origin than raw-prompt bars
Two raw-prompt bars for one model stack and overlap vertically
X-axis 0 to 80 scale has no unit label
Value labels sit beside the wrong rows in places, such as 46% and 42%
